test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
Six teachers A, D,G, J, M and P are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). M is third to the left of G. D is to the immediate left of J. A is to the immediate left of M.

If we count in clockwise direction from P, then how many teachers are sitting between P and J?
solution:
1. M is third to the left of G.

2. A is to the immediate left of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/707971994c9badfb5b9af26f6f410f1bbeba0db8e28fb27354ddcee09960d338.png] 

3. D is to the immediate left of J. (only one place left according to this statement)

4. P sits to the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56b8bd477985a4549fca2ccd6eb2077b05d6a8c67f7e53f04fe6b990e07082e9.png] 

So, there are 1 teacher are sitting between P and J.

Thus, the correct answer is “1”.

**Note - **

Clockwise means - Left of P. (There is only 1 person between P and J)
